name: Front road approach
caption: East-facing 30 ft road frontage with the main facade, gate line, balcony, and independent access.
sellingPoint: Strong street presence for rental appeal.

name: Gate and facade
caption: Modern front facade uses simple bands, balcony glazing, a parking opening, and clear tenant entry.
sellingPoint: Looks polished without depending on expensive cladding.

name: Covered parking
caption: Covered SUV bay, bike parking, meter wall, underground sump zone, and separated tenant/stair movement.
sellingPoint: Practical parking without sacrificing the stair.

name: Ground-floor 2BHK entry
caption: Ground floor family unit uses the front lobby and internal living/kitchen spine.
sellingPoint: Premium family rental on the easiest access level.

name: Ground-floor living
caption: Living, pooja corner, TV wall, and dining connection are grouped near the east-side entry.

name: Ground-floor kitchen
caption: Kitchen, sink, fridge, washing point, and wet-wall logic align with plumbing shafts.
sellingPoint: Lower plumbing cost and easier maintenance.

name: Pooja corner
caption: The pooja location is kept near the living area with a NE-friendly planning intent.
sellingPoint: Small but visible devotional space for family tenants.

name: Common staircase
caption: Common stair stays independently reachable for upper-floor tenants and terrace access.

name: First-floor 1BHK
caption: First floor includes a full 1BHK with living, bedroom, kitchen, bathroom, and utility logic.
sellingPoint: A stable mid-rent unit above the family floor.

name: First-floor balcony
caption: Front balcony increases perceived value, shading, and street connection for the first floor.

name: Single-room unit
caption: Single-room unit has an attached washroom and compact appliance/wardrobe planning.
sellingPoint: Good fit for students, staff, or single professionals.

name: Second-floor studio
caption: Studio/caretaker room keeps the terrace usable while adding a compact support unit.
sellingPoint: Flexible caretaker or low-cost rental option.

name: Terrace and water tank
caption: Terrace drying area, overhead tank zone, and future expansion readiness are kept legible.
sellingPoint: Serviceable roof without blocking future work.

name: Evening facade view
caption: Warm facade lights, balcony plane, and road-facing massing show the rental street image.
